messages:
Aisha M: hi team, day 2 here. quick Q: i'm behind our corporate SOCKS proxy and need to run a few streaming smoke tests. should i use sandbox or hosted keys for local dev? also need to get a stable egress IP whitelisted for a short window. any fast path?

DevEx Bot: Welcome Aisha! :wave: Use sandbox keys for local/dev work. Hosted keys are for staging/prod. Sandbox has lower default quotas. Grab one at Console -> API Keys.

Aisha M: thanks. is there a devproxy that makes traffic originate from a known IP so security can whitelist?

Simon - Infra: yes  we have two options: run local devproxy (still egresses from your machine), or request org-forwarder (hosted) which egresses from 198.51.100.10. Org-forwarder requires an infra ticket for a short-lived client token.

Harper - Security: if you want the whitelist fast, include the exact IP (198.51.100.10), start/end time, and owner. We prefer timeboxed exceptions and a contact for the test window.

Aisha M: perfect. what's the sandbox default quota and streaming concurrency? don't want to accidentally trigger 429s while ramping tests.

DevEx Bot: FYI default sandbox quotas = 60 req/min and 8 concurrent streaming sessions per key. For bursts, file an infra ticket with RPS and time window.

Lina (DevEx): tips to avoid 429s: ramp gradually, use exponential backoff + jitter, and check Retry-After/X-RateLimit-* headers. For streaming, pace by tokens/sec and cap concurrency below per-key limit. If you're running CI, mint ephemeral tokens (one per runner) to spread load.

Aisha M: can someone share a tiny mint-token example for GH Actions?

Simon - Infra: short example:
```
- name: Mint RW token
  run: |
    curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SA_ADMIN }}" https://console.redwood.ai/v1/service_accounts/sa-456/tokens -d '{"ttl":3600}' | jq -r .token > rw_token
    echo "RW_TOKEN=$(cat rw_token)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```
Use RW_TOKEN in your job. Ephemeral tokens help avoid quota hotspots.

Aisha M: awesome. i'll try local smoke tests, then open an infra ticket for org-forwarder + temporary quota bump if needed. tagging @Lina for help tuning the harness. thanks! :raised_hands:
